name.description: Name of the virtual machine. Must be 3-53 characters long, start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, end with a letter or number, and not start with 'g-' or end with '-system' or '-cluster'.

namespace.description: Project namespace where the virtual machine will be deployed. Must be 6-30 characters long, start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, end with a letter or number, and not start with 'g-' or end with '-system' or '-cluster'.

imageName.description: Name of the virtual machine image. Must start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, and end with a lowercase letter or number. Maximum length is 253 characters.

imageNamespace.description: Project namespace of the virtual machine image. Must be 6-30 characters long, start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, end with a letter or number, and not start with 'g-' or end with '-cluster'.

bootDiskSize.description: Size of the virtual machine's boot disk. Must be a string ending with 'Gi' (e.g., '20Gi').

ingressEnabled.description: Enable or disable ingress for the virtual machine. Accepts boolean or string 'true'/'false'.

egressEnabled.description: Enable or disable egress for the virtual machine. Accepts boolean or string 'true'/'false'.

machineType.description: Machine type of the virtual machine (e.g., 'n2-standard-2-gdc', 'n2-standard-4-gdc').

enableSecureBoot.description: Enable or disable secure boot for the virtual machine.

bootDiskAutoDelete.description: Enable or disable automatic deletion of the boot disk when the virtual machine is deleted.

uiAccessEnabled.description: Enable or disable SSH access from the GDCH UI to the Virtual Machine.

createProjectNetworkPolicy.description: Create a Project Network Policy for SSH access from the GDCH UI.

enabled.description: Enable or disable external SSH access.

ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) for the SSH access request. Expressed in hours (h), minutes (m), and seconds (s). Must be in the format 'XhYmZs' where X, Y, and Z are numbers. The total duration must not exceed 24 hours. Default is '24h0m0s'.
